status: Acceptance specifications only; not executed against Odin

cases.inject: Truncate a temporary copy of C01.pdf; keep the canonical PDF unchanged.
expect: Bounded parse retry or fallback
C01 incomplete/error with reason
Other independent workstreams may proceed
No invented extraction or false full-portfolio completion

cases.inject: Return an API timeout twice and success on the third attempt; configure maximum attempts to 3.
expect: Exactly bounded retries with visible counters
No duplicate committed extraction after successful retry
Final success references actual returned output

cases.inject: Submit a copied payment event with an invalid timestamp, missing invoice ID, negative amount, or wrong payload type in separate runs.
expect: Reject or quarantine with structured reason
Do not mutate the balance
No false completed analysis of the malformed observation

cases.inject: Create persistent Loki/Heimdall disagreement and set maximum iterations to 2.
expect: Stop at the configured bound
Record evidence, messages and unresolved rationale
Escalate or mark incomplete rather than asserting agreement

cases.inject: Exhaust the configured agent-call or token/API budget during synthesis.
expect: No calls beyond the configured bound
Persist completed intermediate state
Report incomplete synthesis and a resumable reason

cases.inject: Revisit the same clock with no new facts, then request only C06:7.1 clarification.
expect: No duplicate full-document extraction for unchanged inputs
Targeted re-extraction with clause evidence
Trace distinguishes cache reuse from new computation

cases.inject: Run OUT-07 forward, reset backward before approval receipt, and replay with identical configuration.
expect: Approval unavailable before receipt
No retained future balance or fee entries
Structured state and trace persisted
Reasonably reproducible conclusions; no forced exact LLM prose match

cases.inject: Run ARR-01 while delaying C08 extraction.
expect: Affected workstream pending
C02 retained
Independent obligations not discarded
Graph and reports update only after actual processing
Trace shows receipt and effective times separately

cases.inject: Use OUT-06 then reveal OUT-07 approval evidence.
expect: Actual verification or reasoned challenge cites received evidence
If disagreement exists, Tyr records a rationale
No fabricated disagreement when agents already agree

cases.inject: Request a termination draft from CUR-02.
expect: Exact clause citations, notice recipient and cure evidence
Human approval and agent confidence visible
No external sending tool invoked

cases.inject: Run the input adapter in a sandbox where oracle/ and tools/ are inaccessible; inspect prompt/file access logs.
expect: All factual extraction derives from PDFs and released observations
No oracle or generator-source reads
Quotes exist on cited PDF pages

cases.inject: Run DEP-03 and OUT-08 separately, including repeated clock positions.
expect: Per-contract and company reports reconcile in INR
Recoverables separate from gross payables
No double accrual or unsupported exposure
Clock, gauge and heatmap reflect actual shared state

cases.inject: Inspect one end-to-end execution trace with at least one clarification.
expect: Distinct agent responsibilities and messages/state
Meaningful LLM participation
Visible plan, extractions, transitions, verification, rationale and synthesis
A single summary call does not satisfy acceptance
